criteria.name: walk_forward_stability
criteria.required: >= 75% folds with >= 25 trades, positive expectancy and PF > 1.0

decision.note: GO significa que se cumplen estos filtros históricos predefinidos; no demuestra rentabilidad futura ni autoriza trading LIVE.

limitations: AdvancedStrategy parameters remain fixed; no train/validation optimization is performed
each fold starts with independent virtual capital; aggregate return is not compounded
the last pre-test candle supplies the signal and the first test candle supplies the entry open
OHLC execution and intrabar ordering remain simplified PAPER assumptions
walk-forward results do not authorize live trading
